name: x402 Identity Hub
description: Paid name-availability check for x402 Identity Hub: ENS identity names for AI agents, APIs and MCP servers under 402bot.eth, 402api.eth and 402mcp.eth. GET /v1/availability/:name (e.g. mybot.402bot.eth) costs $0.001 USDC on Base via x402 and returns whether the name is free, the live mint fee and where to register it at x402id.eth.limo.

services.name: availability
services.description: GET, x402 exact scheme: $0.001 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Returns { name, available, mintFee, registerUrl, message }.
